title: The Spanish guitarist with Lee Young and Lester, and Billy Berg's Capri
summary: The guitarist Louis Gonzales played with Lee and Lester; Leo Watson played at Berg's Capri.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: When you were mentioning the guitar player, you were mentioning a musician named Louis Gonzales that you weren't sure you were confusing him --
I'm almost sure he was Nat Cole's guitarist.
Oh, because I was going to ask you about that. I wasn't aware that Nat Cole had a guitarist of Spanish or Mexican --
Yeah, not Nat Cole, Lee Young. Lee and Lester had this guitarist.
Here, when they came, to New York and played Cafe Society downtown, they played the Capri, it was -- what was the fellow's name that owned the Swing Club and the place over on Vine Street.
Billy Berg. Billy Berg had the Capri and Leo Watson's Band played there too.

I can't recall the location geographically in the City. Because I was taken there for the first and the last time and Leo Watson was appearing there. He was playing drums with chair arms. He didn't have any drum sticks.
